verdict.rationale: Better Stack's status-page marketing names first-party integrations with Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus and AWS, so it covers part of the requested stack directly. The evidence stops at a one-line marketing list. Dashboard import from Grafana and Datadog is a migration feature, not an alerting integration, so it adds only marginal weight. missing for 10: documented per-integration setup guides, explicit CloudWatch integration (only generic 'AWS' is named), any Sentry integration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, first-party integrations cover my observability stack — Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, Sentry — with documented setup
